entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Yeni Mosque is a former mosque in the town of Edessa, in the Central Macedonia region of Greece. Completed in the 17th century during the Ottoman era, the mosque was abandoned in 1912 following the Balkan Wars. It is the only surviving mosque of the town, and was repurposed as a history museum in 1942.
